topography.project_purpose: Maia DAO Ecosystem is a decentralized finance protocol that combines a decentralized exchange (Hermes), a yield-bearing token (Maia), and a cross-chain bridge (Ulysses). It enables users to trade, provide liquidity, earn yield, and transfer assets across multiple blockchains.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Maia token (Maia CL and Maia DAO) serves as the central yield and governance asset, while Hermes V1/V2 provide the DEX infrastructure for trading and liquidity. Ulysses bridges assets across chains, likely using Maia as a core asset, and shares the BoringVault infrastructure with the broader ecosystem.
